ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Name As GUID
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a scheduled task with a GUID like name

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ \\"\\{.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ \\'\\{.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/TN\\ \\{.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\}\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\}\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\}\\ .*")))
